<!--
  Loyalty Platform — APIM global service-scope policy.
  Applies to all APIs under this service instance.

  Behaviour:
    1. CORS for portal + localhost dev origins.
    2. Correlation-id propagation (generate if absent).
    3. Dev-only bypass: X-Skip-Auth: true skips validate-jwt (DEV APIM ONLY;
       must be stripped in staging/prod — operators: remove the <choose>
       wrapper entirely when promoting this file to the staging instance).
    4. validate-jwt against B2C JWKS (named values B2C_JWKS_URI, B2C_ISSUER).
    5. Extract tenant + user claims to X-Tenant-ID / X-User-ID headers for
       downstream services.
    6. Strip the X-Skip-Auth header so it cannot be used past the gateway.
-->
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <cors allow-credentials="true">
      <allowed-origins>
        <origin>https://loyalty-dev-admin.azurestaticapps.net</origin>
        <origin>http://localhost:3000</origin>
        <origin>http://localhost:5173</origin>
        <origin>http://localhost:8080</origin>
      </allowed-origins>
      <allowed-methods preflight-result-max-age="300">
        <method>GET</method>
        <method>POST</method>
        <method>PATCH</method>
        <method>PUT</method>
        <method>DELETE</method>
        <method>OPTIONS</method>
      </allowed-methods>
      <allowed-headers>
        <header>Authorization</header>
        <header>Content-Type</header>
        <header>Idempotency-Key</header>
        <header>X-Tenant-ID</header>
        <header>X-Correlation-ID</header>
        <header>X-Skip-Auth</header>
        <header>Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key</header>
      </allowed-headers>
      <expose-headers>
        <header>X-Correlation-ID</header>
      </expose-headers>
    </cors>

    <!-- Correlation-id: propagate client-supplied value or mint one -->
    <set-variable name="correlationId" value="@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-Correlation-ID", Guid.NewGuid().ToString()))" />
    <set-header name="X-Correlation-ID" exists-action="override">
      <value>@((string)context.Variables["correlationId"])</value>
    </set-header>

    <!-- DEV-ONLY: allow X-Skip-Auth: true to bypass JWT validation.
         REMOVE the <choose> wrapper in staging/prod.

         The <validate-jwt> element is additionally gated on the
         B2C_VALIDATE_JWT_ENABLED named value. APIM fetches the OIDC metadata
         at policy-apply time, so we must leave it disabled until the B2C
         tenant (A-06 soft blocker) is live. Operator updates the three named
         values B2C_JWKS_URI, B2C_ISSUER, B2C_VALIDATE_JWT_ENABLED=true via
         `az apim nv update` (see HANDOFF.md for the exact commands).
         No policy re-deploy needed. -->
    <choose>
      <when condition="@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-Skip-Auth", "") != "true")">
        <choose>
          <when condition="@("{{B2C_VALIDATE_JWT_ENABLED}}" == "true")">
            <validate-jwt header-name="Authorization"
                          failed-validation-httpcode="401"
                          failed-validation-error-message="Unauthorized"
                          require-expiration-time="true"
                          require-signed-tokens="true">
              <openid-config url="{{B2C_JWKS_URI}}" />
              <required-claims>
                <claim name="iss" match="any">
                  <value>{{B2C_ISSUER}}</value>
                </claim>
              </required-claims>
            </validate-jwt>
          </when>
        </choose>

        <!-- Extract tenantId claim (B2C custom attr or Entra tid) -->
        <set-variable name="tenantId" value="@{
            var auth = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Authorization","");
            var parts = auth.Split(' ');
            if (parts.Length < 2) { return ""; }
            var jwt = parts[1].AsJwt();
            if (jwt == null) { return ""; }
            if (jwt.Claims.ContainsKey("extension_tenantId")) { return jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("extension_tenantId", ""); }
            return jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("tid", "");
        }" />
        <set-variable name="userId" value="@{
            var auth = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Authorization","");
            var parts = auth.Split(' ');
            if (parts.Length < 2) { return ""; }
            var jwt = parts[1].AsJwt();
            if (jwt == null) { return ""; }
            return jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("sub", "");
        }" />
        <set-header name="X-Tenant-ID" exists-action="override">
          <value>@((string)context.Variables["tenantId"])</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="X-User-ID" exists-action="override">
          <value>@((string)context.Variables["userId"])</value>
        </set-header>
      </when>
      <otherwise>
        <!-- Dev bypass: require explicit headers so nothing is implicit -->
        <choose>
          <when condition="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-Tenant-ID","")))">
            <return-response>
              <set-status code="400" reason="Bad Request" />
              <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                <value>application/problem+json</value>
              </set-header>
              <set-body>{"type":"about:blank","title":"X-Tenant-ID required in dev bypass","status":400,"code":"VALIDATION_ERROR"}</set-body>
            </return-response>
          </when>
        </choose>
      </otherwise>
    </choose>

    <!-- Strip the dev bypass header so it never reaches the backend -->
    <set-header name="X-Skip-Auth" exists-action="delete" />
  </inbound>
  <backend />
  <outbound>
    <set-header name="X-Correlation-ID" exists-action="override">
      <value>@((string)context.Variables["correlationId"])</value>
    </set-header>
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
      <value>application/problem+json</value>
    </set-header>
  </on-error>
</policies>

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Loyalty Platform — Member Service
  description: |
    Member enrollment, profile, lookup, status, GDPR export/delete, and ledger
    pagination for the Loyalty Platform. Multi-tenant. All endpoints under
    `/v1/members` require bearer-JWT auth (or `X-Skip-Auth: true` in dev APIM only).
    Tenant is resolved from the JWT `tid` / `extension_tenantId` claim and
    forwarded to the backend as `X-Tenant-ID`.
  version: "1.0.0"
  contact:
    name: Loyalty Platform Team
servers:
  - url: https://loyalty-dev-apim-5rdrqh.azure-api.net/member
    description: Dev APIM gateway (member-service API)
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
tags:
  - name: Members
  - name: GDPR
  - name: Ledger
paths:
  /v1/members:
    post:
      tags: [Members]
      summary: Enroll a new member
      operationId: enrollMember
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/EnrollMemberRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/MemberDTO'
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '409':
          description: Duplicate member
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      existingMemberId: { type: string, format: uuid }
    get:
      tags: [Members]
      summary: Lookup member by phone or email (POS hot path)
      operationId: lookupMember
      parameters:
        - in: query
          name: phone
          schema: { type: string }
          description: Either `phone` or `email` is required.
        - in: query
          name: email
          schema: { type: string, format: email }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/MemberSummaryDTO'
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
  /v1/members/{id}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MemberIdPath'
    get:
      tags: [Members]
      summary: Get member by id
      operationId: getMember
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/MemberDTO' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
    patch:
      tags: [Members]
      summary: Update member profile
      operationId: patchMember
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/PatchMemberRequest' }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/MemberDTO' }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Conflict' }
    delete:
      tags: [GDPR]
      summary: GDPR soft-delete
      operationId: deleteMember
      responses:
        '204': { description: Deleted }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
  /v1/members/{id}/status:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MemberIdPath'
    post:
      tags: [Members]
      summary: Change member status
      operationId: changeMemberStatus
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/StatusChangeRequest' }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/MemberDTO' }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
        '422':
          description: Invalid status transition
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      from: { type: string }
                      to: { type: string }
  /v1/members/{id}/export:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MemberIdPath'
    get:
      tags: [GDPR]
      summary: GDPR data export
      operationId: exportMember
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/MemberExportDTO' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
  /v1/members/{id}/ledger:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MemberIdPath'
    get:
      tags: [Ledger]
      summary: Paginated points ledger
      operationId: getLedger
      parameters:
        - in: query
          name: after
          schema: { type: string }
          description: Opaque cursor = base64url(ledger_id)
        - in: query
          name: limit
          schema: { type: integer, default: 50, minimum: 1, maximum: 200 }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/LedgerPage' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  parameters:
    MemberIdPath:
      name: id
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
  responses:
    ValidationError:
      description: Validation error
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
    Unauthorized:
      description: Unauthorized
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
    Forbidden:
      description: Forbidden (tenant mismatch)
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
    NotFound:
      description: Not found
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
    Conflict:
      description: Conflict
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
  schemas:
    Problem:
      type: object
      description: RFC 7807 problem+json
      required: [type, title, status, code]
      properties:
        type: { type: string }
        title: { type: string }
        status: { type: integer }
        detail: { type: string }
        code: { type: string }
        instance: { type: string }
    EnrollMemberRequest:
      type: object
      required: [phone, firstName, lastName, enrolledChannel]
      properties:
        email: { type: string, format: email }
        phone: { type: string }
        firstName: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 100 }
        lastName:  { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 100 }
        dateOfBirth: { type: string, format: date }
        enrolledChannel:
          type: string
          enum: [pos, ecommerce, mobile, admin]
    PatchMemberRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName: { type: string }
        lastName: { type: string }
        email: { type: string, format: email }
        phone: { type: string }
        communicationPrefs:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
    StatusChangeRequest:
      type: object
      required: [status, reason]
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [active, suspended, closed]
        reason: { type: string }
    MemberDTO:
      type: object
      required: [id, tenantId, status, tierId, tierName, pointsBalance, firstName, lastName, phone, enrolledChannel, enrolledAt, createdAt, updatedAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        tenantId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        status: { type: string, enum: [active, suspended, closed] }
        tierId: { type: string }
        tierName: { type: string }
        pointsBalance: { type: integer }
        firstName: { type: string }
        lastName: { type: string }
        email: { type: string, format: email }
        phone: { type: string }
        dateOfBirth: { type: string, format: date }
        enrolledChannel: { type: string }
        enrolledAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
        communicationPrefs:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
        createdAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
        updatedAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    MemberSummaryDTO:
      type: object
      required: [id, firstName, lastName, tierId, tierName, pointsBalance, eligibleOffers]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        firstName: { type: string }
        lastName: { type: string }
        tierId: { type: string }
        tierName: { type: string }
        pointsBalance: { type: integer }
        eligibleOffers:
          type: array
          items: { type: object }
    LedgerEntryDTO:
      type: object
      required: [id, memberId, delta, balanceAfter, reason, createdAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        memberId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        transactionId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        delta: { type: integer }
        balanceAfter: { type: integer }
        reason: { type: string }
        note: { type: string }
        createdAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    LedgerPage:
      type: object
      required: [items]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/LedgerEntryDTO' }
        nextCursor: { type: string }
    MemberExportDTO:
      type: object
      required: [profile, ledgerSummary, transactions]
      properties:
        profile: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/MemberDTO' }
        ledgerSummary:
          type: object
          properties:
            count: { type: integer }
            balance: { type: integer }
        transactions:
          type: object
          properties:
            note: { type: string }

<!--
  API-scope inbound policy for member-service.
  Sets the backend base URL (named value) and strips hop-by-hop headers.
-->
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <set-backend-service base-url="{{MEMBER_SERVICE_BACKEND_URL}}" />
    <!-- Connection / Keep-Alive / Transfer-Encoding / Upgrade are restricted
         by APIM and stripped automatically at the gateway. -->
    <set-header name="Proxy-Authorization" exists-action="delete" />
    <!-- Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key must not leak to the backend -->
    <set-header name="Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" exists-action="delete" />
  </inbound>
  <backend><base /></backend>
  <outbound><base /></outbound>
  <on-error><base /></on-error>
</policies>

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Loyalty Platform — Loyalty Engine
  description: |
    Transaction processing, points calculation, immutable ledger, idempotent
    writes, redemptions, and admin adjustments. All write endpoints require an
    `Idempotency-Key` header. Admin endpoints additionally require the `admin`
    role claim on the JWT.
  version: "1.0.0"
servers:
  - url: https://loyalty-dev-apim-5rdrqh.azure-api.net/engine
    description: Dev APIM gateway (loyalty-engine API)
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
tags:
  - name: Transactions
  - name: Redemptions
  - name: Balance
  - name: Admin
paths:
  /v1/transactions:
    post:
      tags: [Transactions]
      summary: Create an earn transaction
      operationId: createTransaction
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateTransactionRequest' }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateTransactionResponse' }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Conflict' }
  /v1/transactions/{id}/void:
    parameters:
      - name: id
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
    post:
      tags: [Transactions]
      summary: Void a committed transaction
      operationId: voidTransaction
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [reason]
              properties:
                reason: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/VoidTransactionResponse' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '403':
          description: Outside void window
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Conflict' }
  /v1/members/{id}/adjustments:
    parameters:
      - name: id
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
    post:
      tags: [Admin]
      summary: Manual ledger adjustment (admin only)
      operationId: adminAdjustment
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AdjustmentRequest' }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AdjustmentResponse' }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }
  /v1/members/{id}/balance:
    parameters:
      - name: id
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
    get:
      tags: [Balance]
      summary: Current balance
      operationId: getBalance
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BalanceDTO' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
  /v1/redemptions:
    post:
      tags: [Redemptions]
      summary: Burn points for an offer redemption
      operationId: createRedemption
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RedemptionRequest' }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RedemptionResponse' }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
        '422':
          description: Insufficient balance
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  parameters:
    IdempotencyKey:
      name: Idempotency-Key
      in: header
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, maxLength: 200 }
      description: Required on all write endpoints. Retention 24h per (tenantId, key).
  responses:
    ValidationError:
      description: Validation error
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
    Unauthorized:
      description: Unauthorized
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
    Forbidden:
      description: Forbidden
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
    NotFound:
      description: Not found
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
    Conflict:
      description: Conflict (idempotency reuse)
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
  schemas:
    Problem:
      type: object
      required: [type, title, status, code]
      properties:
        type: { type: string }
        title: { type: string }
        status: { type: integer }
        detail: { type: string }
        code: { type: string }
        instance: { type: string }
    SkuLine:
      type: object
      required: [sku, amount]
      properties:
        sku: { type: string }
        categoryId: { type: string }
        amount: { type: integer, description: Minor currency units }
    CreateTransactionRequest:
      type: object
      required: [memberId, channel, amount, currency, occurredAt]
      properties:
        memberId: { type: string, format: uuid }
        channel:
          type: string
          enum: [pos, ecommerce, mobile, admin]
        amount: { type: integer, minimum: 0, description: Minor units }
        currency: { type: string, minLength: 3, maxLength: 3 }
        skuList:
          type: array
          items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/SkuLine' }
        locationId: { type: string }
        occurredAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    AppliedMultiplier:
      type: object
      properties:
        source: { type: string }
        multiplier: { type: number }
        points: { type: integer }
    CreateTransactionResponse:
      type: object

<!--
  API-scope inbound policy for loyalty-engine.
  - Sets backend base URL
  - Strips hop-by-hop headers
  - Enforces Idempotency-Key header on POST /v1/transactions (and by extension
    all POST endpoints on this API: /void, /adjustments, /redemptions).
-->
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <set-backend-service base-url="{{LOYALTY_ENGINE_BACKEND_URL}}" />
    <!-- Connection / Keep-Alive / Transfer-Encoding / Upgrade are restricted
         by APIM and stripped automatically at the gateway. -->
    <set-header name="Proxy-Authorization" exists-action="delete" />
    <set-header name="Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" exists-action="delete" />

    <choose>
      <when condition="@(context.Request.Method == "POST" && string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Idempotency-Key", "")))">
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="400" reason="Bad Request" />
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/problem+json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body>{"type":"about:blank","title":"Idempotency-Key header required","status":400,"code":"VALIDATION_ERROR","detail":"All POST endpoints on loyalty-engine require a client-supplied Idempotency-Key header."}</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
    </choose>
  </inbound>
  <backend><base /></backend>
  <outbound><base /></outbound>
  <on-error><base /></on-error>
</policies>

<!--
  Product-scope rate limit.

  NOTE: APIM Consumption tier does NOT support rate-limit-by-key; it only
  supports the plain rate-limit policy which is gateway-wide per product.
  In a higher tier we would partition by Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key or the
  tenant claim. Decision logged in /infra/apim/HANDOFF.md.
-->
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <rate-limit calls="1000" renewal-period="60" />
  </inbound>
  <backend><base /></backend>
  <outbound><base /></outbound>
  <on-error><base /></on-error>
</policies>
